Builds tests/fixtures/voice/voice_corpus.json (the shared, labelled voice-ordering corpus) from the compact table below.

Run:  uv run python tests/fixtures/voice/build_corpus.py   then   sh scripts/sync_voice_fixtures.sh <web-business-admin dir>
The JSON is what both parsers are tested against (pos-service tests/test_voice_corpus.py, web src/lib/voiceCorpus.test.ts).
